 7547:         run_dir: Path,
 7548:         state: dict[str, Any],
 7549:         config: Config,
 7550:         master_plan: dict[str, Any],
 7551:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 7552:         pending = state.get("pending_commit")
 7553:         if not isinstance(pending, dict) or not isinstance(pending.get("candidate_id"), str):
 7554:             raise FactoryError("committing state has no valid pending candidate", "blocked")
 7555:         expected_candidate = pending["candidate_id"]
 7556:         task_id = state.get("current_task_id")
 7557:         if not isinstance(task_id, str):
 7558:             raise FactoryError("committing state has no current task", "blocked")
 7559:         task = next((item for item in master_plan_tasks(master_plan) if item["id"] == task_id), None)
 7560:         if task is None:
 7561:             raise FactoryError("pending commit task is not present in the master plan", "blocked")
 7562:         worktree_raw = state.get("worktree")
 7563:         if not isinstance(worktree_raw, str) or not Path(worktree_raw).is_dir():
 7564:             raise FactoryError("pending commit worktree is missing", "blocked")
 7565:         worktree = Path(worktree_raw)
 7566:         base_commit = state.get("base_commit")
 7567:         if not isinstance(base_commit, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", base_commit):
 7568:             raise FactoryError("pending commit has an invalid base commit", "blocked")
 7569:         review_ref = state.get("review_ref")
 7570:         if not isinstance(review_ref, str) or not review_ref:
 7571:             raise FactoryError("pending commit has no review reference", "blocked")
 7572:         review_path = (run_dir / review_ref).resolve()
 7573:         try:
 7574:             review_path.relative_to(run_dir.resolve())
 7575:         except ValueError as exc:
 7576:             raise FactoryError("pending review reference escapes the run directory", "blocked") from exc
 7577:         if not review_path.is_file():
 7578:             raise FactoryError("pending review artifact is missing", "blocked")
 7579:         review = read_json(review_path)
 7580:         if state.get("candidate_id") != expected_candidate:
 7581:             raise FactoryError("pending commit candidate is not bound to run state", "blocked")
 7582:         pending_base = pending.get("base_commit")
 7583:         if pending_base != base_commit:
 7584:             raise FactoryError("pending commit base does not match the approved base", "blocked")
 7585:         pending_review_hash = pending.get("reviewed_diff_sha256")
 7586:         if pending_review_hash != review.get("reviewed_diff_sha256"):
 7587:             raise FactoryError("pending commit review hash is not bound to the approval", "blocked")
 7588:         if pending.get("review_ref") != review_ref:
 7589:             raise FactoryError("pending commit review reference is not bound to the approval", "blocked")
 7590:         pending_candidate_state = pending.get("candidate_state_identity")
 7591:         state_candidate_state = state.get("candidate_state_identity")
 7592:         if (
 7593:             not isinstance(pending_candidate_state, dict)
 7594:             or not isinstance(state_candidate_state, dict)
 7595:             or pending_candidate_state.get("complete_identity_sha256")
 7596:             != state_candidate_state.get("complete_identity_sha256")
 7597:         ):
 7598:             raise FactoryError("pending commit candidate state is not bound to the approval", "blocked")
 7599:         if pending.get("verification_ref") != state.get("verification_ref"):
 7600:             raise FactoryError("pending commit verification reference is not bound to the approval", "blocked")
 7601:         verification_ref = state.get("verification_ref")
 7602:         if not isinstance(verification_ref, str):
 7603:             raise FactoryError("pending commit has no verification provenance", "blocked")
 7604:         verification_contract = self._validate_verification_attestation(
 7605:             run_dir,
 7606:             verification_ref,
 7607:             attestation_sha256=state.get("verification_attestation_sha256"),
 7608:             expected_task_id=task_id,
 7609:             expected_base_commit=base_commit,
 7610:             expected_candidate_id=expected_candidate,
 7611:             expected_command=normalize_test_command(config.test_command) if config.test_command else None,
 7612:         )
 7613:         verification_sha256 = verification_contract["attestation_sha256"]
 7614:         if pending.get("verification_sha256") != verification_sha256:
 7615:             raise FactoryError("pending commit verification digest is not bound to the approval", "blocked")
 7616:         review_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(review_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 7617:         if pending.get("review_sha256") != review_sha256:
 7618:             raise FactoryError("pending commit review artifact integrity is stale", "blocked")
 7619:         if review.get("verification") != verification_contract:
 7620:             raise FactoryError("pending commit verification is not bound to the approval", "blocked")
 7621: 
 7622:         head = git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
 7623:         if head != base_commit:
 7624:             parent = git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD^").stdout.strip()
 7625:             tree = git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}").stdout.strip()
 7626:             if parent != base_commit or tree != expected_candidate:
 7627:                 raise FactoryError("pending commit does not match the approved base/tree", "blocked")
 7628:             post_commit_state = AgyBuilder._candidate_baseline_identity(worktree)
 7629:             if (
 7630:                 post_commit_state.get("head") != head
 7631:                 or post_commit_state.get("tree") != expected_candidate
 7632:                 or post_commit_state.get("status_records")
 7633:                 or post_commit_state.get("staged_diff_sha256")
 7634:                 != hashlib.sha256(b"").hexdigest()
 7635:                 or post_commit_state.get("unstaged_diff_sha256")
 7636:                 != hashlib.sha256(b"").hexdigest()
 7637:                 or not post_commit_state["clean"]
 7638:             ):
 7639:                 raise FactoryError(
 7640:                     "pending commit has post-approval candidate mutations",
 7641:                     "blocked",
 7642:                 )
 7643:             committed_diff = git(
 7644:                 worktree, "diff", f"{base_commit}..{head}", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff"
 7645:             ).stdout
 7646:             validate_review(
 7647:                 review,
 7648:                 hashlib.sha256(committed_diff.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
 7649:                 base_commit,
 7650:                 expected_candidate,
 7651:                 list(task.get("global_criteria", []))
 7652:                 + [item["id"] for item in task.get("acceptance_criteria", [])],
 7653:                 verification_contract,
 7654:             )
 7655:             if review.get("decision") != "APPROVE":
 7656:                 raise FactoryError("pending commit reconciliation requires Sol APPROVE", "blocked")
 7657:             commit_hash = head
 7658:         else:
 7659:             staged_diff = git(worktree, "diff", "--cached", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff").stdout
 7660:             current_hash = hashlib.sha256(staged_diff.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
 7661:             current_tree = git(worktree, "write-tree").stdout.strip()
 7662:             unstaged_diff = git(worktree, "diff", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff").stdout
 7663:             current_candidate_state = AgyBuilder._candidate_baseline_identity(worktree)
 7664:             reviewed_candidate_state = state.get("candidate_state_identity")
 7665:             validate_review(
 7666:                 review,
 7667:                 current_hash,
 7668:                 base_commit,
 7669:                 expected_candidate,
 7670:                 list(task.get("global_criteria", []))
 7671:                 + [item["id"] for item in task.get("acceptance_criteria", [])],
 7672:                 verification_contract,
 7673:             )
 7674:             if review.get("decision") != "APPROVE":
 7675:                 raise FactoryError("pending commit reconciliation requires Sol APPROVE", "blocked")
 7676:             if current_tree != expected_candidate or unstaged_diff:
 7677:                 raise FactoryError("pending candidate changed before commit reconciliation", "blocked")
 7678:             if (
 7679:                 not isinstance(reviewed_candidate_state, dict)
 7680:                 or current_candidate_state.get("complete_identity_sha256")
 7681:                 != reviewed_candidate_state.get("complete_identity_sha256")
 7682:             ):
 7683:                 raise FactoryError("pending candidate state changed before commit reconciliation", "blocked")
 7684:             message = (
 7685:                 f"hermes: {task['objective'].strip()[:68]}\n\n"
 7686:                 f"Factory-Run: {identifier}\n"
 7687:                 f"Sol-Model: {config.sol_model}\n"
 7688:                 f"Builder-Model: {config.builder_model}\n"
 7689:                 f"Reviewed-Diff-SHA256: {current_hash}\n"
 7690:                 f"Candidate-Tree: {expected_candidate}"
 7691:             )
 7692:             committed = command(["git", "commit", "-m", message], cwd=worktree, timeout=120)
 7693:             if committed.returncode != 0:
 7694:                 raise FactoryError(
 7695:                     f"pending commit reconciliation failed: {(committed.stderr or committed.stdout).strip()}",
 7696:                     "blocked",
 7697:                 )
 7698:             commit_hash = git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
 7699:             if git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}").stdout.strip() != expected_candidate:
 7700:                 raise FactoryError("reconciled commit tree does not match the pending candidate", "blocked")
 7701: 
 7702:         completed_commits = state.get("completed_commits")
 7703:         if not isinstance(completed_commits, list):
 7704:             raise FactoryError("run completed_commits state is invalid", "state")
 7705:         completed_commits = list(completed_commits)
 7706:         existing = next(
 7707:             (item for item in completed_commits if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("task_id") == task_id),
 7708:             None,
 7709:         )
 7710:         completed_record = {
 7711:             "task_id": task_id,
 7712:             "commit": commit_hash,
 7713:             "candidate_id": expected_candidate,
 7714:             "base_commit": base_commit,
 7715:         }
 7716:         if existing is None:
 7717:             completed_commits.append(completed_record)
 7718:         elif existing.get("commit") != commit_hash or existing.get("candidate_id") != expected_candidate:
 7719:             raise FactoryError("completed task history conflicts with pending commit", "blocked")
 7720:         state["completed_commits"] = completed_commits
 7721:         state["base_commit"] = commit_hash
 7722:         state["candidate_id"] = None
 7723:         state["pending_commit"] = None
 7724:         state["active_attempt_ref"] = None
 7725:         task_evidence = next(
 7726:             (
 7727:                 item
 7728:                 for item in (state.get("criterion_evidence") or {}).values()
 7729:                 if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("task_id") == task_id
 7730:             ),
 7731:             None,
 7732:         )
 7733:         if (
 7734:             not isinstance(task_evidence, dict)
 7735:             or not isinstance(task_evidence.get("review_sha256"), str)
 7736:             or not isinstance(task_evidence.get("verification_sha256"), str)
 7737:             or not isinstance(task_evidence.get("verification_sequence"), int)
 7738:         ):
 7739:             raise FactoryError("pending commit lacks bound verification provenance", "blocked")
 7740:         self._record_approved_criteria(
 7741:             state,
 7742:             task,
 7743:             review,
 7744:             base_commit=base_commit,
 7745:             candidate_id=expected_candidate,
 7746:             review_ref=str(state.get("review_ref")),
 7747:             verification_ref=state.get("verification_ref"),
 7748:             review_sha256=task_evidence["review_sha256"],
 7749:             verification_sha256=task_evidence["verification_sha256"],
 7750:             verification_sequence=task_evidence["verification_sequence"],
 7751:             review_criteria_ids=task_evidence.get("review_criteria_ids"),
 7752:         )
 7753:         self._record_committed_task_criteria(state, master_plan, task)
 7754:         self._bind_criteria_to_commit(state, task_id, commit_hash)
 7755:         self._save(
 7756:             run_dir,
 7757:             state,
 7758:             "planned",
 7759:             commit=commit_hash,
 7760:             current_task_id=task_id,
 7761:             completed_commits=completed_commits,
 7762:             criterion_evidence=state["criterion_evidence"],
 7763:             pending_commit=None,
 7764:             candidate_id=None,
 7765:             candidate_state_identity=None,
 7766:             active_attempt_ref=None,
 7767:         )
 7768:         return state
 7769: 
 7770:     def _validate_terminal_state(
 7771:         self,
 7772:         identifier: str,
 7773:         run_dir: Path,
 7774:         state: dict[str, Any],
 7775:         config: Config,
 7776:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 7777:         """Revalidate a terminal snapshot before trusting its fast path."""
 7778:         def invalid(reason: str) -> None:
 7779:             self._save(
 7780:                 run_dir,
 7781:                 state,
 7782:                 "blocked",
 7783:                 block_reason=reason,
 7784:                 error=reason,
 7785:                 error_category="blocked",
 7786:             )
 7787:             raise FactoryError(reason, "blocked")
 7788: 
 7789:         try:
 7790:             plan = self._load_master_plan_for_execution(run_dir, config, state)
 7791:             tasks = master_plan_tasks(plan)
 7792:             completed = state.get("completed_commits")
 7793:             if not isinstance(completed, list) or not completed:
 7794:                 invalid("terminal state has no completed commit history")
 7795:             task_ids: set[str] = set()
 7796:             plan_ids = {task["id"] for task in tasks}
 7797:             for record in completed:
 7798:                 if not isinstance(record, dict):
 7799:                     invalid("terminal state has an invalid completed commit record")
 7800:                 task_id = record.get("task_id")
 7801:                 commit = record.get("commit")
 7802:                 candidate_id = record.get("candidate_id")
 7803:                 base_commit = record.get("base_commit")
 7804:                 if (
 7805:                     not isinstance(task_id, str)
 7806:                     or task_id in task_ids
 7807:                     or not isinstance(commit, str)
 7808:                     or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", commit)
 7809:                     or not isinstance(candidate_id, str)
 7810:                     or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", candidate_id)
 7811:                     or not isinstance(base_commit, str)
 7812:                     or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", base_commit)
 7813:                 ):
 7814:                     invalid("terminal state has an invalid or duplicate completed commit record")
 7815:                 if task_id not in plan_ids:
 7816:                     invalid("terminal state references a task absent from the master plan")
 7817:                 task_ids.add(task_id)
 7818:                 if git(Path(config.repo), "rev-parse", f"{commit}^").stdout.strip() != base_commit:
 7819:                     invalid("terminal state commit parent does not match its recorded base")
 7820:                 if git(Path(config.repo), "rev-parse", f"{commit}^{{tree}}").stdout.strip() != candidate_id:
 7821:                     invalid("terminal state commit tree does not match its recorded candidate")
 7822:             if task_ids != plan_ids:
 7823:                 invalid("terminal state is missing a committed master-plan task")
 7824:             if state.get("commit") != completed[-1].get("commit"):
 7825:                 invalid("terminal state latest commit is not bound to completed history")
 7826:             if state.get("current_task_id") is not None:
 7827:                 invalid("terminal state retains a current task")
 7828:             if any(state.get(key) is not None for key in ("candidate_id", "pending_commit", "active_attempt_ref")):
 7829:                 invalid("terminal state retains an ambiguous candidate or attempt")
 7830:             if state.get("test_results") not in (None, []):
 7831:                 invalid("terminal state retains duplicate mutable Runner result state")
 7832:             gaps = self._remaining_master_plan_gaps(plan, state)
 7833:             if gaps:
 7834:                 invalid(f"terminal state has incomplete global criterion evidence: {gaps}")
 7835:             evidence = state.get("criterion_evidence")
 7836:             if not isinstance(evidence, dict):
 7837:                 invalid("terminal state criterion evidence is missing")
 7838:             completed_by_commit = {
 7839:                 item["commit"]: item
 7840:                 for item in completed
 7841:                 if isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("commit"), str)
 7842:             }
 7843:             task_by_id = {task["id"]: task for task in tasks}
 7844:             validated_reviews: set[str] = set()
 7845:             for criterion_id, item in evidence.items():
 7846:                 if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("status") != "PASS":
 7847:                     continue
 7848:                 commit_record = completed_by_commit.get(item.get("commit"))
 7849:                 if commit_record is None or item.get("candidate_id") != commit_record.get("candidate_id"):
 7850:                     invalid(f"terminal state criterion {criterion_id} has stale commit lineage")
 7851:                 task = task_by_id.get(item.get("task_id"))
 7852:                 if task is None:
 7853:                     invalid(f"terminal state criterion {criterion_id} has an unknown task")
 7854:                 review_ref = item.get("review_ref")
 7855:                 verification_ref = item.get("verification_ref")
 7856:                 if not isinstance(review_ref, str) or not review_ref:
 7857:                     invalid(f"terminal state criterion {criterion_id} has no review_ref")
 7858:                 if not isinstance(verification_ref, str) or not verification_ref:
 7859:                     invalid(f"terminal state criterion {criterion_id} has no verification_ref")
 7860:                 verification_contract = self._validate_verification_attestation(
 7861:                     run_dir,
 7862:                     verification_ref,
 7863:                     attestation_sha256=item.get("verification_sha256"),
 7864:                     expected_task_id=item.get("task_id"),
 7865:                     expected_base_commit=item.get("base_commit"),
 7866:                     expected_candidate_id=item.get("candidate_id"),
 7867:                     expected_command=normalize_test_command(config.test_command) if config.test_command else None,
 7868:                 )
 7869:                 if verification_contract.get("sequence") != item.get("verification_sequence"):
 7870:                     invalid(f"terminal state criterion {criterion_id} verification sequence is stale")
 7871:                 review_path = (run_dir / review_ref).resolve()
 7872:                 if not review_path.is_file():
 7873:                     invalid(f"terminal state criterion {criterion_id} references missing review_ref")
 7874:                 review_value = read_json(review_path)
 7875:                 review_hash = item.get("review_sha256")
 7876:                 if (
 7877:                     not isinstance(review_hash, str)
 7878:                     or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", review_hash)
 7879:                     or hashlib.sha256(review_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != review_hash
 7880:                 ):
 7881:                     invalid(f"terminal state criterion {criterion_id} review_ref integrity is stale")
 7882:                 if review_value.get("decision") != "APPROVE":
 7883:                     invalid(f"terminal state criterion {criterion_id} references a non-approval review")
 7884:                 if review_value.get("verification") != verification_contract:
 7885:                     invalid(f"terminal state criterion {criterion_id} review verification is stale")
 7886:                 if review_ref not in validated_reviews:
 7887:                     commit = commit_record["commit"]
 7888:                     committed_diff = git(
 7889:                         Path(config.repo),
 7890:                         "diff",
 7891:                         f"{item['base_commit']}..{commit}",
 7892:                         "--binary",
 7893:                         "--no-ext-diff",
 7894:                     ).stdout
 7895:                     validate_review(
 7896:                         review_value,
 7897:                         hashlib.sha256(committed_diff.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
 7898:                         item["base_commit"],
 7899:                         item["candidate_id"],
 7900:                         item.get("review_criteria_ids")
 7901:                         if isinstance(item.get("review_criteria_ids"), list)
 7902:                         else self._task_review_criteria_ids(self._task_execution_plan(plan, task)),
 7903:                         verification_contract,
 7904:                     )
 7905:                     validated_reviews.add(review_ref)
 7906:             ledger = MemoryLedger(
 7907:                 run_dir,
 7908:                 identifier,
 7909:                 config.repo,
 7910:                 state.get("objective_class", "capability_growth"),
 7911:             )
 7912:             if any(item.get("status") in {"open", "regressed"} for item in ledger.issues.values()):
 7913:                 invalid("terminal state has unresolved ledger findings")
 7914:         except FactoryError as exc:
 7915:             if state.get("phase") != "blocked":
 7916:                 invalid(f"terminal state validation failed: {exc}")
 7917:             raise
 7918:         except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeError) as exc:
 7919:             invalid(f"terminal state evidence is invalid: {exc}")
 7920:         return state
 7921: 
 7922:     def _commit_approved_candidate(
 7923:         self,
 7924:         *,
 7925:         identifier: str,
 7926:         run_dir: Path,
 7927:         state: dict[str, Any],
 7928:         config: Config,
 7929:         plan: dict[str, Any],
 7930:         task_id: str,
 7931:         worktree: Path,
 7932:         diff_text: str,
 7933:         digest: str,
 7934:         changed: list[str],
 7935:         candidate_id: str,
 7936:         review: dict[str, Any],
 7937:         tests: list[dict[str, Any]],
 7938:         checkpoints: list[str],
 7939:         ledger: MemoryLedger,
 7940:         review_sequence: int,
 7941:         finalize_run: bool,
 7942:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 7943:         self._assert_source_unchanged(
 7944:             Path(config.repo), state, run_dir, f"commit_gate_{self._artifact_sequence(review_sequence)}"
 7945:         )
 7946:         self._scope_check(
 7947:             worktree,
 7948:             allowed := plan["allowed_files"],
 7949:             f"commit_gate_{self._artifact_sequence(review_sequence)}",
 7950:             run_dir,
 7951:         )
 7952:         current_diff = git(worktree, "diff", "--cached", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff").stdout
 7953:         current_hash = hashlib.sha256(current_diff.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
 7954:         current_base_commit = git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
 7955:         current_candidate_id = git(worktree, "write-tree").stdout.strip()
 7956:         current_candidate_state = AgyBuilder._candidate_baseline_identity(worktree)
 7957:         reviewed_candidate_state = state.get("candidate_state_identity")
 7958:         unstaged_diff = git(worktree, "diff", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff").stdout
 7959:         # Diff hashes corroborate what Sol was shown. Candidate authority is
 7960:         # the host's current base plus git write-tree result below; the digest
 7961:         # never supplies or replaces the candidate identity.
 7962:         if (
 7963:             current_hash != digest
 7964:             or review.get("decision") != "APPROVE"
 7965:             or review["reviewed_diff_sha256"] != current_hash
 7966:             or review["base_commit"] != current_base_commit
 7967:             or state.get("base_commit") != current_base_commit
 7968:             or review["candidate_id"] != current_candidate_id
 7969:             or current_candidate_id != candidate_id
 7970:             or unstaged_diff
 7971:             or not isinstance(reviewed_candidate_state, dict)
 7972:             or current_candidate_state.get("complete_identity_sha256")
 7973:             != reviewed_candidate_state.get("complete_identity_sha256")
 7974:         ):
 7975:             raise FactoryError("candidate changed after Sol approval; approval invalidated", "hash")
 7976:         review_ref = str(state.get("review_ref") or f"sol_review_{self._artifact_sequence(review_sequence)}.json")
 7977:         verification_ref = state.get("verification_ref")
 7978:         if not isinstance(verification_ref, str):
 7979:             raise FactoryError("approved candidate has no verification artifact", "state")
 7980:         verification_contract = self._validate_verification_attestation(
 7981:             run_dir,
 7982:             verification_ref,
 7983:             attestation_sha256=state.get("verification_attestation_sha256"),
 7984:             expected_task_id=task_id,
 7985:             expected_base_commit=current_base_commit,
 7986:             expected_candidate_id=current_candidate_id,
 7987:             expected_command=normalize_test_command(config.test_command) if config.test_command else None,
 7988:         )
 7989:         verification_sha256 = verification_contract["attestation_sha256"]
 7990:         if review.get("verification") != verification_contract:
 7991:             raise FactoryError("Sol reviewed verification does not match the Runner evidence", "hash")
 7992:         review_path = (run_dir / review_ref).resolve()
 7993:         if not review_path.is_file():
 7994:             raise FactoryError("approved review artifact is missing", "state")
 7995:         review_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(review_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 7996:         self._record_approved_criteria(
 7997:             state,
 7998:             plan,
 7999:             review,
 8000:             base_commit=current_base_commit,
 8001:             candidate_id=current_candidate_id,
 8002:             review_ref=review_ref,
 8003:             verification_ref=verification_ref,
 8004:             review_sha256=review_sha256,
 8005:             verification_sha256=verification_sha256,
 8006:             verification_sequence=verification_contract["sequence"],
 8007:         )
 8008:         message = (
 8009:             f"hermes: {plan['objective'].strip()[:68]}\n\n"
 8010:             f"Factory-Run: {identifier}\n"
 8011:             f"Sol-Model: {config.sol_model}\n"
 8012:             f"Builder-Model: {config.builder_model}\n"
 8013:             f"Reviewed-Diff-SHA256: {current_hash}\n"
 8014:             f"Candidate-Tree: {current_candidate_id}"
 8015:         )

 8565:     def _execute_one_task(
 8566:         self,
 8567:         identifier: str,
 8568:         plan: dict[str, Any],
 8569:         task_id: str | None,
 8570:         *,
 8571:         perform_preflight: bool,
 8572:         finalize_run: bool,
 8573:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 8574:         run_dir, state, config = self._load(identifier)
 8575:         if finalize_run and state["phase"] in {"committed", "complete"}:
 8576:             return self._validate_terminal_state(identifier, run_dir, state, config)
 8577:         state.setdefault("luna_invocation_count", 0)
 8578:         completed_for_offset = state.get("completed_commits")
 8579:         completed_offset = len(completed_for_offset) * 1000 if isinstance(completed_for_offset, list) else 0
 8580:         existing_artifact_numbers = [
 8581:             int(match.group(1))
 8582:             for path in run_dir.iterdir()
 8583:             if (match := re.search(r"_(\d+)(?:\.[^.]+)$", path.name))
 8584:         ]
 8585:         maximum_existing = max(existing_artifact_numbers, default=-1)
 8586:         self._artifact_offset = max(completed_offset, maximum_existing + 1)
 8587:         allowed = plan["allowed_files"]
 8588:         ensure_paths_confined(Path(config.repo), allowed)
 8589:         previous_tests = state.get("test_results")
 8590:         tests: list[dict[str, Any]] = list(previous_tests) if isinstance(previous_tests, list) else []
 8591:         previous_checkpoints = state.get("checkpoints")
 8592:         checkpoints: list[str] = (
 8593:             list(previous_checkpoints) if isinstance(previous_checkpoints, list) else []
 8594:         )
 8595:         previous_review_cycles = state.get("review_cycles", 0)
 8596:         if isinstance(previous_review_cycles, bool) or not isinstance(previous_review_cycles, int) or previous_review_cycles < 0:
 8597:             raise FactoryError("run has invalid review cycle count", "state")
 8598: 
 8599:         root_obj_class = state.get("objective_class") or classify_objective(config.request)["classification"]
 8600:         ledger = MemoryLedger(run_dir, identifier, config.repo, root_obj_class)
 8601: 
 8602:         try:
 8603:             self._save(run_dir, state, "preflight_execution", error=None, error_category=None)
 8604:             # All three capabilities are proven before creating or changing the task worktree.
 8605:             if perform_preflight:
 8606:                 self._capability_preflight(run_dir, state, config)
 8607:                 ledger.record_event(phase="preflight_execution", action="capability_preflight", result="success")
 8608:             self._assert_source_unchanged(Path(config.repo), state, run_dir, "before_worktree")
 8609:             worktree = self._create_worktree(run_dir, state, config)
 8610:             ledger.record_event(
 8611:                 phase="worktree",
 8612:                 action="create_worktree",
 8613:                 result="success",
 8614:                 details={"branch": state.get("branch")},
 8615:             )
 8616:             ensure_paths_confined(worktree, allowed)
 8617:             self._scope_check(worktree, allowed, "before_builder", run_dir)
 8618:             cp_initial = self._create_checkpoint(worktree, run_dir, "initial")
 8619:             checkpoints.append("initial")
 8620:             ledger.record_event(phase="checkpoint", action="checkpoint_initial", result="success")

 8622:             repair_history: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

 8624:             def capture_repair_failure(
 8625:                 result: dict[str, Any], stage: str
 8626:             ) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
 8627:                 diff = git(
 8628:                     worktree,
 8629:                     "diff",
 8630:                     "--binary",
 8631:                     "--no-ext-diff",
 8632:                     "HEAD",
 8633:                     "--",
 8634:                     *allowed,
 8635:                 ).stdout
 8636:                 candidate_fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(diff.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
 8637:                 failure = {
 8638:                     "source": "Test Runner",
 8639:                     "code": "ambiguous_test_failure",
 8640:                     "criterion_ids": [],
 8641:                     "returncode": result.get("returncode"),
 8642:                     "log": result.get("log"),
 8643:                 }
 8644:                 repair_history.append(
 8645:                     {
 8646:                         "stage": stage,
 8647:                         "sequence": result.get("sequence"),
 8648:                         "candidate_fingerprint": candidate_fingerprint,
 8649:                         "failure_signature": failure_signature(failure),
 8650:                         "log": result.get("log"),
 8651:                     }
 8652:                 )
 8653:                 state["luna_invocation_count"] = 0
 8654:                 state["repair_evidence"] = repair_history
 8655:                 atomic_json(
 8656:                     run_dir / "repair_evidence.json",
 8657:                     {
 8658:                         "luna_invocation_count": 0,
 8659:                         "attempts": repair_history,
 8660:                     },
 8661:                 )
 8662:                 return candidate_fingerprint, failure

 8677:                     },
 8678:                 )

 5940:     def _candidate_source_context(
 5941:         self,
 5942:         worktree: Path,
 5943:         allowed: list[str],
 5944:         changed: list[str],
 5945:         candidate_id: str,
 5946:         run_dir: Path,
 5947:         sequence: int,
 5948:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 5949:         """Build a bounded, read-only source snapshot for Sol's review.
 5950: 
 5951:         The index is used instead of the working tree so the reviewer sees the
 5952:         exact candidate that will be hash-checked, including newly created or
 5953:         deleted files. Planner and repair transcripts are deliberately omitted.
 5954:         """
 5955:         artifact_sequence = self._artifact_sequence(sequence)
 5956:         preferred_budget = 24_000
 5957:         remaining = preferred_budget
 5958:         files: dict[str, Any] = {}
 5959:         ordered_paths = list(dict.fromkeys(list(changed) + sorted(set(allowed) - set(changed))))
 5960:         for relative in ordered_paths:
 5961:             shown = command(["git", "show", f":{relative}"], cwd=worktree, timeout=30)
 5962:             if shown.returncode != 0:
 5963:                 files[relative] = {"state": "deleted-or-absent"}
 5964:                 continue
 5965:             raw = shown.stdout
 5966:             if "\x00" in raw:
 5967:                 files[relative] = {"state": "binary-or-non-text", "included": False}
 5968:                 continue
 5969:             # The budget is a soft prompt-shaping preference, not an evidence
 5970:             # invariant. Always retain the complete text of a small affected
 5971:             # file; larger context is permitted when it is the useful evidence
 5972:             # for a finding. Unchanged files are progressively disclosed only
 5973:             # after affected files have been considered.
 5974:             if relative in changed and len(raw) <= max(preferred_budget, 48_000):
 5975:                 excerpt = raw
 5976:             else:
 5977:                 excerpt = raw[: min(len(raw), max(remaining, 12_000))]
 5978:             files[relative] = {
 5979:                 "state": "present",
 5980:                 "content": excerpt,
 5981:                 "truncated": len(excerpt) < len(raw),
 5982:             }
 5983:             remaining -= len(excerpt)
 5984:             if remaining <= 0 and relative not in changed:
 5985:                 break
 5986:         context = {
 5987:             "source": "staged index exact candidate state",
 5988:             "base_commit": git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip(),
 5989:             "candidate_id": candidate_id,
 5990:             "files": files,
 5991:             "preferred_context_budget_chars": preferred_budget,
 5992:             "context_chars": sum(
 5993:                 len(item.get("content", "")) for item in files.values() if isinstance(item, dict)
 5994:             ),
 5995:             "soft_budget_exceeded": remaining < 0,

 8566:         self,
 8567:         identifier: str,
 8568:         plan: dict[str, Any],

 8570:         *,

 8573:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 8574:         run_dir, state, config = self._load(identifier)
 8575:         if finalize_run and state["phase"] in {"committed", "complete"}:
 8576:             return self._validate_terminal_state(identifier, run_dir, state, config)
 8577:         state.setdefault("luna_invocation_count", 0)

 8579:         completed_offset = len(completed_for_offset) * 1000 if isinstance(completed_for_offset, list) else 0
 8580:         existing_artifact_numbers = [
 8581:             int(match.group(1))

 8583:             if (match := re.search(r"_(\d+)(?:\.[^.]+)$", path.name))
 8584:         ]

 8586:         self._artifact_offset = max(completed_offset, maximum_existing + 1)
 8587:         allowed = plan["allowed_files"]
 8588:         ensure_paths_confined(Path(config.repo), allowed)
 8589:         previous_tests = state.get("test_results")
 8590:         tests: list[dict[str, Any]] = list(previous_tests) if isinstance(previous_tests, list) else []
 8591:         previous_checkpoints = state.get("checkpoints")

 8593:             list(previous_checkpoints) if isinstance(previous_checkpoints, list) else []
